# AutoPend | WebSathi

> Two services run by Kartikey Gupta, a full-stack developer with 7+ years of experience, serving businesses across India remotely. Both offer a free, no-obligation consultation before any quote.

## Services

- [AutoPend](https://autopend.in/automation/): Business process automation, AI automation, and internal tools for established Indian businesses (manufacturers, distributors, retailers, service businesses). Free 30-minute audit. Real client work: Sunpress Organics, Lex & Ledger, Liv'Oh.
- [WebSathi](https://autopend.in/webdev/): Professional website development for established Indian businesses (manufacturers, distributors, retailers, service businesses), including e-commerce. Free 30-minute consultation before any quote. Real client work: Liv'Oh, Sunpress Organics, Lex & Ledger, kartikeygupta.co.
